card.name: Is/are before excreted in breast milk
card.fires_on: The verb "is" or "are" right after a drug name in nursing-mother or pregnancy sections, where the next words are about excretion in milk or crossing the placenta.

modes.label: Nursing mothers: drug is excreted
modes.description: "is" or "are" after a drug name under a Nursing Mothers heading, before "excreted in human milk".

modes.label: Placenta and tissue passage
modes.description: "are" in a list of verbs describing how a drug crosses the placenta and reaches fetal tissues or milk.
modes.example: tetracyclines cross the placenta,<< are>> found in fetal tissues

card.writes: It adds little that is clear; promoted tokens loosely relate to safety and passing through the body.
card.plain: It fires on the little verb after a drug name when the label is about to say the drug passes into breast milk or across the placenta.
